rationale: The Court will likely resolve the case narrowly under Rule 4(a)(2) as construed in FirsTier: a notice filed after an announced dispositive decision becomes effective only upon later entry of a final judgment, and only where the announced decision would be appealable if immediately reduced to judgment. Any separate writing would most likely emphasize either textual limits (to avoid “manufacturing” jurisdiction) or fairness/access-to-appeal concerns for pro se and incarcerated litigants.
